_about: Public goldens: Logic's own saves of a blank project, one change per save. Paths are relative to resources/; bin/run fetch-corpus puts the files there. Facts are what tests may assert.

blank-base.note: an empty project with one audio track, Logic's first save

modes-count-in-logic.note: Count In pressed on (count-in was Off)

modes-base-b-logic.note: a second base: every mode off, count-in off

toggle: Set Punch In/Out Locator by Playhead

tracks-two-audio-logic.note: Track > New Audio Track on the blank project

stack-folder-logic.note: Create Track Stack (Folder) over all three tracks, on a project that had none

stack-summing-logic.note: Create Track Stack (Summing) over all three tracks

stack-summing-flattened-logic.note: Flatten Stack on the summing stack

tracks-four-audio-logic.note: Track > New Tracks… (Audio, input 1) added a fourth track after the selected one

stack-folder-of-one-logic.note: Create Track Stack (Folder) over the selected Audio 1 alone, four tracks in the project

stack-header-reordered-logic.note: the stack header dragged two rows down; header and member moved as a block

levels-ours.note: levels --to by owner onto the base: the Click channel's fader 127 -> 120

send-bus-1-logic.note: a send from Audio 1 to Bus 1 made in the inspector's Sends menu, level as Logic sets a new send

send-level-1-logic.note: the send knob dragged up once

send-level-2-logic.note: the send knob dragged up again

send-two-base-3-logic.note: a second send (Audio 1 -> Bus 2): Logic moved every channel's slot base word from 2 to 3 and the Click instrument to key 3

group-drums-logic.note: Logic's re-save of a group made by `logic group --create` over Audio 1 and Audio 2 on a blank-born project

group-leave-logic.note: Audio 1 set to No Group in the strip's Group popup

arrangement-track-logic.note: Track > Global Tracks > Arrangement Track shown on the flattened three-track project

arrangement-section-1-selected-logic.note: section 1 clicked in the arrangement lane

tracks-instrument-logic.note: Track > New Software Instrument Track with Audio 1 selected

select-audio-1-logic.note: Audio 1's track header clicked (the instrument track was selected before)

inserts-channel-eq-logic.note: Channel EQ inserted on Audio 1 from the inspector strip's Audio FX menu

inserts-native-logic.note: Compressor inserted below Channel EQ on Audio 1

inserts-native-all-logic.note: Gain, ChromaVerb, SilverVerb, EnVerb, Echo and Enveloper inserted after the first two

midi-empty-region-logic.note: Pencil tool click on Inst 1 at bar 3: one empty one-bar MIDI region

midi-one-note-logic.note: Event List > Create new Event with the playhead at bar 3: one note; ticks are absolute, bar 1 = 38400 (the region starts at bar 3 = 46080)

midi-note-pitch-62-logic.note: the note's Num set to 62 in the Event List

midi-note-base-logic.note: the pitch-62 note again, with cycle on and the Event List open: base for the note-edit pairs

midi-note-velocity-79-logic.note: the note's Val nudged in the Event List (80 -> 79)

midi-note-length-960-logic.note: the note's Length set to 0 1 0 0 (one beat)

midi-two-notes-logic.note: Create new Event again with the playhead at bar 3: a second note

midi-pitch-bend-logic.note: Create with the type popup on Pitch Bend

midi-controller-logic.note: Create with the type popup on Controller

midi-program-change-logic.note: Create with the type popup on Progr. Change

midi-region-unlooped-logic.note: a re-save of the program-change state; base for the loop pair

midi-region-looped-logic.note: the region selected and L pressed (Loop on in the region inspector)

signature-meter-3-4-logic.note: the initial time signature's numerator set to 3 in the Signature List

route-ours.note: logic route --output 'Audio 2=Bus 1' on the flattened three-track project

transplant-ours.note: logic transplant of Audio 1's Channel EQ + Compressor from the inserts save onto the flattened project

send-packaged-ours.note: logic send --add 'Audio 1=Bus 1' on a project with no send: the packaged send template

stack-ours.note: logic stack-create --name Drums over Audio 1 and Audio 2 on Logic's three flat tracks: the packaged first-stack pattern

arrangement-ours.note: logic arrangement --add 1:8:Intro:custom on the flattened project, which had no arrangement track

stack-sub2-ours.note: logic stack-create --name Drums on the flattened project, whose flattened stack left a Sub 1 strip behind

midi-import-resave-logic.note: Logic's new project from the .mid that `logic midi --export` wrote from midi-region-looped-logic, saved once

reorder-ours.note: logic reorder --move 'Audio 3:before:Audio 1' on Logic's three flat tracks

reorder-resave-logic.note: Logic's re-save of reorder-ours; the moved row's selection mark (+79 bit 6) came back cleared, every other row byte held

midi-write-ours.note: logic midi --region 'Inst 1:3:1' --note 'Inst 1:3:60:80:240' --note 'Inst 1:3.5:64:100:480:2' on the eight-insert save

midi-write-resave-logic.note: Logic's re-save of midi-write-ours; Logic re-numbered the sequence ids and showed the instrument's preset name on the un-named track

audio-one-region-logic.note: File > Import > Audio File… of a one-second 44.1 kHz mono WAV onto Audio 2 at bar 1 (the bundle's Media folder is not staged; the file record names it)

audio-three-regions-logic.note: the same WAV imported again onto Audio 3 (Logic copied it as v030-tone_1.wav), then a two-second 48 kHz stereo WAV onto Audio 3 (converted to 44.1 kHz on import)

audio-write-ours.note: logic regions --audio 'Audio 2:1:v030-tone.wav' on the MIDI-write re-save (the bundle's Media folder is not staged)

audio-write-resave-logic.note: staged as Logic's re-save of audio-write-ours, but its records are Logic's own import (audio-one-region-logic) saved again: the region record and its UUID match that save, not ours; only the folder path and one qeSM differ

sessionplayer-track-logic.note: Track > New Session Player SI Track… with the defaults (Create): a drummer track with one generated region

sessionplayer-complexity-logic.note: the editor's Complexity slider dragged up

sessionplayer-fills-logic.note: the Fill Amount knob dragged up

patch-audio-1-logic.note: Library > Save… on Audio 1 of the eight-insert project: the patch bundle Logic 12.3.1 writes (#Root.cst + data.plist)

patch-built-loaded-logic.note: the patch logic patch --build made from the saved patch's #Root.cst, installed in the user library and chosen from the Library's User Patches on Audio 2

send-three-base-4-logic.note: a third send (Audio 1 -> Bus 3) picked in the Sends slot's search field: Logic moved every channel's slot base word from 3 to 4

signature-list-base-logic.note: the blank project with the List Editors pane shown and the playhead put at bar 5 beat 3 by a click on the ruler

signature-meter-created-logic.note: Create pressed in the Signature List (type Time): Logic made 5/4 on the next bar line after the playhead, bar 6

signature-meter-5-8-bar-6-logic.note: the new event's denominator set to /8 in the list

signature-key-created-logic.note: Create with the type set to Key: Logic made F major at the playhead, bar 5 beat 3

signature-key-a-minor-logic.note: the new key event set to A minor in its popup

tempo-point-created-logic.note: Create pressed in the Tempo List: a 120 bpm point at the playhead, bar 5 beat 3

tempo-point-140-logic.note: the new point set to 140 bpm in the list

audio-write-two-ours.note: logic regions --audio 'Audio 2:1:v030-tone.wav' --audio 'Audio 3:2:v030-tone2.wav' (1 s mono, then 2 s stereo, 44.1 kHz) on the MIDI-write re-save (the bundle's Media folder is not staged)

audio-write-two-resave-logic.note: Logic's re-save of audio-write-two-ours; on load Logic rewrote each file record's folder path and file size, and the stereo file's +531 word

midi-names-ours.note: logic midi --region 'Inst 1:2:2:Keys' --region 'Inst 1:5:1:Pad Layer' --note 'Inst 1:2:60:100:480' --note 'Inst 1:5.5:64:90:240' on the instrument-track save

midi-names-resave-logic.note: Logic's re-save of midi-names-ours; Logic renumbered the sequence ids and rewrote the byte 225 past each region's name

midi-edits-ours.note: logic midi --transpose 1=2 --velocity 1=0.8 --quantize 2=1/8 --move 2=120 --delete 3:40 --remap 3=gm:addictive-drums-2 --copy-region '1=Inst 1:12' --copy-notes '2=Inst 1:3' on a copy of midi-names-resave-logic that had first gained notes in both regions and a GM drum region ('Drums GM', bar 9)

midi-edits-resave-logic.note: Logic's re-save of midi-edits-ours: every region and event as written, the sequence ids renumbered

regions-a00-base-logic.note: the v0.3.0 three-audio-regions save with its MIDI region: session A's base

regions-a01-audio-moved-logic.note: audio region 'v030-tone' nudged one bar right

regions-a02-audio-start-trimmed-logic.note: its start nudged one beat right: first frame 22050, 22050 frames

regions-a04-audio-split-logic.note: 'v030-tone2' split at bar 1.5: piece 'v030-tone2.1' from frame 44100, 22050 frames

regions-a08-midi-end-trimmed-logic.note: its length nudged to three beats

regions-a09-midi-start-trimmed-logic.note: its start nudged one beat right; the notes keep their time

regions-a10-midi-split-logic.note: split at bar 4.5: a second 'Inst 1' with its own sequence

regions-a18-fade-in-speed-up-logic.note: its Fade In type Speed Up (saved after A19)

regions-a20-crossfade-logic.note: 'v030-tone2.1' nudged a beat left under Drag: X-Fade, overlapping 'tone renamed'

markers-a24-moved-logic.note: the first moved to bar 6 in the Marker List

regions-a26-import-e-acute-logic.note: File > Import > Audio File of v040-é.wav (NFD on disk) at bar 9

regions-a28-import-kanji-logic.note: import of v040-日本.wav at bar 13

regions-a30-midi-rename-logic.note: the first MIDI region renamed 'Pad — é'

beats-place-generate-ours.note: logic beats place (a library pattern, --repeat) and beats generate (a seeded phrase) onto a copy of midi-two-notes-logic over a synthetic groovebin library

beats-compose-ours.note: logic beats compose --fills over the arrangement's sections onto a copy of midi-two-notes-logic

regions-midi-edits-resave-logic.note: Logic's re-save of regions-midi-edits-ours: every region, entry, record and the split piece's sequence offset as written

markers-edits-resave-logic.note: Logic's re-save of markers-edits-ours: both markers as written

regions-audio-edits-resave-logic.note: Logic's re-save of regions-audio-edits-ours: every region, the split's second piece and record, the mute, name, loop and fades as written
